units.source_text: 舞女看上去约莫十七岁光景。

en.t: The dancer looked to be about seventeen years old.

units.source_text: 她梳着一个我叫不上名字的大发髻，发型古雅而又奇特。

en.t: She wore a large coiffure whose name I did not know, an old-fashioned and unusual hairstyle.

units.source_text: 这种发式，把她那严肃的鹅蛋形脸庞衬托得更加玲珑小巧，十分匀称，真是美极了。

en.t: That hairstyle set off her solemn oval face, making it seem even more delicate and small; it was beautifully balanced and truly lovely.

units.source_text: 令人感到她活像小说里的姑娘画像，头发特别丰厚。

en.t: She seemed just like a portrait of a girl from a novel, with especially abundant hair.

units.source_text: 舞女的同伴中，有个四十出头的妇女、两个年轻的姑娘，还有一个二十五六岁的汉子，

en.t: Among the dancer's companions were a woman a little over forty, two young girls, and a man of about twenty-five or twenty-six,

units.source_text: 他身穿印有长冈温泉旅馆字号的和服外褂。

en.t: who was wearing a kimono haori printed with the name of an inn at Nagaoka Hot Spring.
